emulator._source: the world's own docs/setup_en.md: "Retroarch is only emulator this client will accept." Its client launches retroarch.exe with cores/mupen64plus_next_libretro.dll.

client.name: Gauntlet Legends Client
client._kind_source: The world registers its own Archipelago client and carries the code that talks to the emulator, so London installs the apworld and starts the emulator only. Its own registration, read from the package's __init__.py: `Component("Gauntlet Legends Client", func=launch_client, component_type=Type.CLIENT, file_identifier=SuffixIdentifier(".apgl"))`
client._protocol_source: measured in the world's own gl/GauntletLegendsClient.py: a UDP socket to 127.0.0.1:55355 speaking READ_CORE_RAM / WRITE_CORE_RAM. ⚠ It uses READ_CORE_RAM (core-relative), NOT READ_CORE_MEMORY (system-bus) -- the two read different address spaces.

_bridge_note: London's RetroArch bridge was written for this game (extensions/retroarch). It also turns on RetroArch's network commands and sets the N64 core's CountPerOp=1 -- two steps the world's guide asks the player to do by hand.
